protect.reason: vendored Hairline UI. Restyle with tokens in globals.css, props or an app wrapper; a real bug goes into packages/ui/hairline/patch.mjs (hairline-ui skill).
vendored shadcn, kept byte-identical for `shadcn add --diff`. Change a token or pick a variant/size (docs/design-system.md, Updating shadcn and Hairline UI).

denyBash.reason: a bare shadcn add of Hairline overwrites shadcn's files. Add it to packages/ui/hairline/items.json and run `pnpm --filter @workspace/ui hairline`.
Markdown files and packages/ui/hairline/patch.mjs do not follow prettier; format only the TS/TSX/JSON you changed.
